{{Quote|As was the beginning, so is the end. ''[&hellip;]'' Once, victims. ''[&hellip;]'' Now, victors.|General Bearsh deactivates a Vagaari stasis collar|<ref name="SQ" />}}
The '''Vagaari stasis collar''' was a elaborate<ref name="TUR" /> [[Color/Legends|blue-and-gold]]<ref name="SQ" /> device used by the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to cease a being's life without [[Death/Legends|killing]] them. The stasis collars could be attached to a [[wolvkil]], [[Hair/Legends|furry]] animals used by the [[Vagaari Empire]] to attack their enemies, Vagaari, or their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. The collars could be put for timed release, allowing the Vagaari to execute ambushes.<ref name="TUR" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> Vagaari [[Supreme Commander (Vagaari)|Supreme Commander]] [[Estosh]], [[General]] [[Bearsh]] and several other Vagaari used several<ref name="SQ" /> stasis collars<ref name="TUR" /> to suspend the life of wolvkils they carried on their shoulders. Once they infiltrated a conference room at the remains of the ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] at [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]] [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]], they removed the collars and allowed their animals to [[Battle of the Redoubt|attack]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and several other [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] officials.<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vagaari stasis collar<ref name="TUR" /> first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="SQ" /> [[2010|Six years]] later, ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]'' named them.<ref name="TUR" />
